parameter_classes.source: Inherited qemu/nikon-z9-lab.c synthetic device fixtures; Z8 local assisted runs described in docs/z8-status.md.
parameter_classes.assumptions: Supplies missing initialization/device state; does not restore physical peripheral contents or factory calibration.

parameter_classes.source: Inherited model plus Z8 17-group software table comparison recorded in profiles/z8-c311.json.
parameter_classes.assumptions: Software table layout matches; bootloader window initial values and hardware mappings remain unverified.

parameter_classes.source: Inherited qemu/prepare_source.py ARM SEV patch and gated event handling in qemu/nikon-z9-lab.c.
parameter_classes.assumptions: CPU3 blocking and missing exclusive-monitor events still need Z8-specific investigation; no measured performance claim.

parameter_classes.source: Inherited tools/model-properties.json event timing settings, copied without value changes.
parameter_classes.assumptions: 33333333 ns is a synthetic internal event period, separate from the external 33 ms diagnostic peer; neither establishes sensor or capture frame rate.

parameter_classes.source: Inherited explicit functional inputs in tools/model-properties.json and qemu/nikon-z9-lab.c.
parameter_classes.assumptions: ADC samples, service status, zero results and metadata inputs are synthetic laboratory values, not physical measurements.

parameter_classes.source: Shared QEMU graphics and scanout code; local Z8 assisted menu/scanout record in docs/z8-status.md.
parameter_classes.assumptions: Independent decoding checks scanout consistency; menu image hashes are regression baselines. Neither compares output against a physical camera.

parameter_classes.source: Z8-specific syscon/no-card branch in qemu/nikon-z9-lab.c, exercised by tests/test_z8_syscon.py and tests/test_z8_storage_control.py.
parameter_classes.assumptions: Models an empty SD slot only; does not establish card import, NEF output or real media compatibility.

parameter_classes.source: Shared register, processing and pipeline implementation in qemu/nikon-z9-lab.c; enabled values inherited from tools/model-properties.json.
parameter_classes.assumptions: Functional completions and device state are hypotheses used for assisted Z8 execution, not full silicon, capture, AF or codec validation.

diagnostic_boundary.source: Shared tools/z9_global1_boundary_input.py Peer(guest, period_ms); preserves the prior Z8 runner argument.
diagnostic_boundary.assumptions: External diagnostic delivery interval in QEMU virtual milliseconds, not 33 fps and not a measured CMOS clock. Z8 applicability remains under investigation.
